tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Read a web page as clean Markdown for an LLM. Fetches the URL (robots.txt respected), extracts the main content (drops navigation, headers, footers, sidebars, cookie banners) and returns GitHub-flavoured Markdown with headings, lists, tables, code blocks (with language) and absolute links, plus meta

tools.name: read_urls
tools.description: Read up to 10 web pages as clean Markdown in one call, in parallel: the same output as /v1/read for each URL, with a per-URL ok/error. $0.005 per call (= $0.0005 per page at 10 URLs). Charged only if at least one URL is read successfully. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (charged only on success)

tools.name: about
tools.description: Free. What Readmd does, prices of the paid tools and HTTP endpoints, and links to docs.

tools.name: preview_url
tools.description: Free. Fetches a URL and returns its title, metadata, outline, word and token counts and the first 500 characters of the clean Markdown. Use read_url (paid, $0.001) for the full text.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "read_url" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
